podcast.body: An album released by Leslie Fish, which included the song "Band From Argo," a track specifically about Star Trek. "She released an album entitled Solar Sailors, and it contained a song entitled Band From Argo, which was all about Star Trek."

podcast.body: This album followed her groundbreaking commercial FILK recording from 1976 and included the song "Band From Argo," which was entirely about Star Trek. "The following year she released an album entitled Solar Sailors and it contained a song entitled Band From Argo, which was all about Star Trek."
